points.target: gRPC server surface (CartService: AddItem, GetCart, EmptyCart)

mechanisms.name: replication
mechanisms.resolution_path: redis-cart Deployment declares no `replicas:` field (defaults to 1); no StatefulSet, no Sentinel/Cluster configuration found anywhere in the manifest set

mechanisms.name: fallback
mechanisms.resolution_path: all four RedisCartStore methods (AddItemAsync, GetCartAsync, EmptyCartAsync, and the constructor's connectivity check) catch Exception only to re-throw as RpcException(FailedPrecondition) — this is error translation for the gRPC boundary, not graceful degradation

mechanisms.name: timeout
mechanisms.resolution_path: AddStackExchangeRedisCache configured with only `options.Configuration = redisAddress`; no SyncTimeout, ConnectTimeout, or AsyncTimeout override found. StackExchange.Redis library defaults would apply but are not explicitly declared in this repository.

mechanisms.name: connection_pool
mechanisms.resolution_path: StackExchange.Redis multiplexes over a single persistent connection by design; the 'pool' concept as scored in this profile does not map onto this client model

mechanisms.name: readiness_probe
mechanisms.resolution_path: readinessProbe.grpc.port=7070 targets the gRPC health service; the Check() handler calls `_cartStore.Ping()` and returns NotServing when the ping fails, rather than an unconditional success

mechanisms.name: liveness_probe
mechanisms.resolved_value: PRESENT — same real check as readiness

mechanisms.name: self_healing
mechanisms.condition_applied: prerequisite (specific, real liveness probe) satisfied -> full weight
mechanisms.resolution_path: k8s default restart policy acts on the liveness probe above, which is a genuine health signal

mechanisms.name: graceful_shutdown
mechanisms.resolution_path: ASP.NET Core / Kestrel has a default SIGTERM-triggered graceful shutdown via IHostApplicationLifetime, but no explicit shutdown timeout override or custom drain logic was found in this repo; the behaviour present is an un-configured framework default rather than something this repo explicitly declares

mechanisms.name: declared_resource_limits
mechanisms.resolved_value: PRESENT — cpu+memory, both requests AND limits
mechanisms.resolution_path: requests: cpu=200m, memory=64Mi; limits: cpu=300m, memory=128Mi

totals.note: 0.03 below the Acceptable threshold (3.0) — closest tier boundary case in the corpus so far.

remediation.action: Add graceful shutdown logic explicitly (e.g., a bounded IHostApplicationLifetime.ApplicationStopping handler that stops accepting new gRPC calls and drains in-flight ones)
remediation.rationale: Currently UNVERIFIED, not penalized, but also not credited — making it explicit is what would let this score improve, since the underlying framework behavior cannot be credited on the basis of an assumed default.

remediation.action: Add an explicit Redis connect/sync timeout to AddStackExchangeRedisCache options
remediation.rationale: Closes the DI vertical's timeout gap; single highest-value action available on this service.

remediation.action: Add Redis replication (Sentinel or a managed HA Redis) rather than a single unreplicated pod
remediation.rationale: The current single-instance redis-cart Deployment is this service's largest structural exposure — the cart store has no redundancy at all.

remediation.action: Add a fallback path for read operations (e.g., serve an empty or last-known cart on Redis failure) distinct from the current catch-and-rethrow
remediation.rationale: Converts every Redis blip into a hard failure for the end user today; a degraded response is often preferable to a hard error for cart reads specifically.

remediation.action: Add a rate limiter or bulkhead at the gRPC entry surface
remediation.rationale: Nothing currently bounds concurrent load on this service.

remediation.action: Add a startup probe and a PodDisruptionBudget
